name: rina_maps_itinerary_1
prompt:
Vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail in the style of a bold Japanese tech-news magazine cover. ONE single continuous illustration filling the whole canvas edge to edge (no panels, no frames, no collage, no blurred edges); every area has a role, no empty space. LAYOUT (percent from the top): the title block sits in the upper half, from 5% to 50%, three tiers with strong size contrast: tier 1 = a medium white word with a thick navy outline; tier 2 = the biggest, heaviest words, slightly tilted, with a thick dark outline and a deep 3D extrusion shadow, spanning at least 90% of the image width (edge to edge inside the safe margins); its color must stand out strongly from the background hue: on an orange/yellow background use WHITE letters with a very thick navy or black outline (never yellow on orange), yellow letters only on dark navy/blue/purple backgrounds; tier 3 = a small white text on a colored ribbon or banner. The girl (the attached character: same face, silver braided hair, blue jacket) is in the lower part, her head at about 50% and her body down to the bottom edge, taking about 40% of the image height, slightly right of center, holding or using the topic object described below; the topic object and the scene fill the rest of the lower part. Clean bold 2D anime style, vivid saturated colors, strong contrast, strong rim light. SAFE MARGINS: every letter of every text (all tiers and badges) and the girl's face must stay at least 5% of the image height away from the top and bottom edges and at least 3% of the width away from the left and right edges; keep the top-right corner (right 14%, top 12%) free of text because a menu button covers it there. Use the full width for the title: tiers 1 and 2 should run almost edge to edge. The background, her body and objects still extend to all edges. All Japanese text perfectly spelled exactly as given, no other text, no real brand logos, no watermark. No tiny decorative patterns or sparkles.
Colors: dark navy with glowing cyan and blue neon. Scene: the girl holds a big smartphone toward the viewer; the screen shows a stylized coastal road map with a thick purple route and red numbered pins 1, 2, 3; behind her a sunny ocean coastline highway and a small suitcase; she points at the phone with a surprised, excited face. Title: tier 1 'Googleマップ新機能'; tier 2 '旅程をAIが作る' (yellow); tier 3 ribbon (orange) '予約の空きも探す'. No real Google logo or app icon, any phone screen shows only a simple stylized map (no letters or numbers except the small numbered pins 1 2 3).
